subject.title: feat: add publisher feed query and delta state

question: Should ClawHub adopt this durable publisher-feed revision/change protocol now, and if so should the foundational publisher snapshot work land before this delta-state branch is rebased and reviewed as a narrower follow-up?
rationale: The code defines a durable external protocol and persisted-history semantics across multiple dependent PRs; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide the permanent protocol boundary or merge order.

options.title: Land foundations, then narrow this PR
options.body: Approve the protocol direction, land the publisher snapshot foundation first, and require this branch to rebase to its query/delta-specific changes with live proof.

options.title: Adopt the full stacked protocol together
options.body: Accept the shared publisher-feed model, delta history, signing dependency, and RFC direction as one coordinated release plan.

options.title: Pause pending RFC resolution
options.body: Defer the storage and public-contract work until the RFC settles the durable query, reset, and signed-distribution behavior.

recommendation.title: Land foundations, then narrow this PR
recommendation.body: Approve the protocol direction, land the publisher snapshot foundation first, and require this branch to rebase to its query/delta-specific changes with live proof.
